tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen background. Plain white in light mode, like the apps people already use.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, the bottom navigation bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Filter chips, progress tracks, the search field, list groups on a white screen.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (uploader, date, relation, helper text) on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. 5.3:1 or better.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and above the bottom bar. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outlined button borders, the Add button ring. 3:1 or better on surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one accent: main buttons, links, the active tab, selected chip, upload progress.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill. 6.2:1 or better.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Tonal buttons, the active tab pill, the uploading chip and info banners. Holds primary or ink text.

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: Recording only: the record button, the live dot. Icons on it use on-record.

tokens.name: on-record
tokens.usage: Icons on a record fill (not body text).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: 'Saved' text and icon on success-tint. Always with the check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the saved chip.

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: 'Waiting for internet' text and icon on waiting-tint.

tokens.name: waiting-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the waiting chip and the 'Drive almost full' note.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on surface and danger-tint. Danger buttons.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the failed chip.

tokens.name: focus
